'''March 2002 Carmel tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Carmel, Indiana on 9 March 2002. It is known from Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3495">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-12-richs-money-tournamentd3495/ richs-money-tournament], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 12 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-12-richs-money-tournamentd3495/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 March 2002
* '''Site:''' Carmel, Indiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Players:''' 24
